verdict.rationale: Ollama documents its own cloud alongside local models in the same tooling: you can run larger models on Ollama's Cloud without downloading them, use local and cloud base URLs, and `ollama launch` runs coding tools with either local or cloud models. There is no evidence that it connects to third-party cloud providers such as OpenAI or Anthropic as model backends. The OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible APIs and the Claude/ChatGPT app links let outside clients use Ollama, which is the reverse direction. Missing for 10: support for third-party cloud provider backends (bring-your-own API key for OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.), evidence of switching between local and cloud models in a single UI, independent hands-on corroboration.
